blocks.prompt: 11. Let \(f\) be continuous and suppose: \(\int_{0}^{2} f(x)\,dx = 10\) and \(\int_{2}^{4} f(x)\,dx = 6\). If the average value of \(f\) on \([0, 3]\) equals the average value on \([3, 4]\), find \(\int_{3}^{4} f(x)\,dx\).
blocks.explanation:
Is dafa do anjaan (unknown) tukre hain: \(A = \int_2^3 f\) aur \(B = \int_3^4 f\), aur un ka jama 6 hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\int_0^2 f = 10\), \(\int_2^4 f = 6\), aur \([0, 3]\) aur \([3, 4]\) ke averages barabar.
Find kya karna hai? \(B\).
Plan: dono averages \(A\) aur \(B\) mein likho, barabar rakho, aur \(A = 6 - B\) rakh kar ek hi unknown wali equation hal karo.
steps:
Dono averages
\[f_{\text{av}}[0, 3] = \dfrac{10 + A}{3}, \qquad f_{\text{av}}[3, 4] = \dfrac{B}{1} = B\]
Kyun: \([0, 3]\) ki lambai 3 aur \([3, 4]\) ki 1 hai; \(\int_0^3 = \int_0^2 + \int_2^3 = 10 + A\).

Barabar rakhein aur \(A = 6 - B\) lagayein
\[\dfrac{10 + A}{3} = B\]
\[10 + (6 - B) = 3B\]
\[16 = 4B \Rightarrow B = 4\]
Kyun: \(A + B = 6\) se \(A = 6 - B\); ise rakhne se sirf \(B\) bacha aur seedhi equation ban gayi.
Dhyan dein: \(\int_0^3\) ko \(10\) ya \(16\) samajh lena ghalat hai; \([0, 3]\) mein \([2, 4]\) ka sirf aadha nahin balke \([2, 3]\) wala anjaan hissa \(A\) aata hai.
